data.title: Bürgergeld benefit decision (Bewilligungsbescheid) for Dec 2026 – Nov 2027
data.summary: Jobcenter Beispiel-Oderland approved Bürgergeld (basic income support) for Ronny Musterspree from 1 December 2026 to 30 November 2027. The monthly benefit is €1,041.30, including €478.30 for housing and heating costs, and the landlord's 2025 utility cost statement must be submitted by 8 January 2027.
data.explanation: The Jobcenter has granted your Bürgergeld for a one-year period starting 1 December 2026. Please send in your landlord's 2025 utility cost statement (Nebenkostenabrechnung) by the stated date, as your heating cost portion is only provisional until then. If you disagree with the amount or any part of this decision, you may file a written objection (Widerspruch) with the Jobcenter; the app shows the deadline for this. Before the approval period ends on 30 November 2027, make sure a follow-up decision or new application is in place so your payments continue without interruption.
